subject: Numeric literals
notes: kb/Work PB1445: ONE contiguity test (ArithmeticFormationRules.SignAbuts, on the tokens' stream indices, never GetText) answers rule 2 everywhere. LiteralScreenPass screens every signed literal slot of the tree (signedNumericLiteral — MOVE/ADD/DISPLAY literal operands — and signedIntegerLiteral), so `MOVE - 5`, `ADD - 5`, `DISPLAY - 5`, `MOVE - .5` draw COBOL2155 instead of reading -5; the VALUE clause (every format writes literal-n, §13.18.63.2) accepts a signed operand only when SoleOperand.NumericLiteral calls it ONE literal, so `VALUE --5` (was CS1059 in the backend), `+-5`, `- 5`, a sign split across lines and `88 C1 VALUE - 5` draw COBOL2155 naming the broken sentence. `-5`, `+4`, `MOVE -3`, `ADD -2` stay literals and `IF A = - 5` / `COMPUTE A = - 5 * 2` stay unary operators in an expression (85/pb1445_signed_literal_forms). retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Validation/LiteralScreenPass.cs#ScreenSign (kb/Work PB1616 moved LiteralScreenPass (Compiler/Validation) to LiteralScreen (Frontend/Parsing) so the directive lane asks the same body; the witness is the same code at its new path)
